verses.text: يَا رَبُّ إِلهِي، عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ. خَلِّصْنِي مِنْ كُلِّ الَّذِينَ يَطْرُدُونَنِي وَنَجِّنِي،

excerpts: David Prays Against His Enemies; Prayer for Sinners and Saints. Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the Lord, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.

verses.text: لِئَلاَّ يَفْتَرِسَ كَأَسَدٍ نَفْسِي هَاشِمًا إِيَّاهَا وَلاَ مُنْقِذَ.

excerpts: David Prays Against His Enemies; Prayer for Sinners and Saints. Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the Lord, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.

verses.text: يَا رَبُّ إِلهِي، إِنْ كُنْتُ قَدْ فَعَلْتُ هذَا. إِنْ وُجِدَ ظُلْمٌ فِي يَدَيَّ.

excerpts: David Prays Against His Enemies; Prayer for Sinners and Saints. Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the Lord, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.

verses.text: إِنْ كَافَأْتُ مُسَالِمِي شَرًّا، وَسَلَبْتُ مُضَايِقِي بِلاَ سَبَبٍ،

excerpts: David Prays Against His Enemies; Prayer for Sinners and Saints. Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the Lord, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.

verses.text: فَلْيُطَارِدْ عَدُوٌّ نَفْسِي وَلْيُدْرِكْهَا، وَلْيَدُسْ إِلَى الأَرْضِ حَيَاتِي، وَلْيَحُطَّ إِلَى التُّرَابِ مَجْدِي. سِلاَهْ.

excerpts: David Prays Against His Enemies; Prayer for Sinners and Saints. Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the Lord, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.

verses.text: قُمْ يَا رَبُّ بِغَضَبِكَ. ارْتَفِعْ عَلَى سَخَطِ مُضَايِقِيَّ وَانْتَبِهْ لِي. بِالْحَقِّ أَوْصَيْتَ.

excerpts: David Prays Against His Enemies; Prayer for Sinners and Saints. Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the Lord, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.

verses.text: وَمَجْمَعُ الْقَبَائِلِ يُحِيطُ بِكَ، فَعُدْ فَوْقَهَا إِلَى الْعُلَى.

excerpts: David Prays Against His Enemies; Prayer for Sinners and Saints. Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the Lord, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.
